course.title: Fluid Mechanics and Machinery
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value:
A single acting reciprocating pump has a plunger of 80 mm diameter and a stroke 15   
of length 150 mm. It takes its supply of water from a sump 3 m below the pump   
through a pipe 4.5 m long and 30 mm diameter. It delivers water to a tank 12 m   
above the pump through a pipe 25 mm diameter and 15 m long. If separation   
occurs at 78.48 kN/m<sup>2</sup> below atmospheric pressure, find the maximum speed at   
which the pump may be operated without separation. Assume the plunger to have   
simple harmonic motion.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
